claims: 2026-27 budget delivered 12 May 2026; CGT and negative gearing reforms from 1 July 2027 passed Parliament in June 2026; proposed 30% minimum tax on discretionary trusts still a bill
whys: These are typed news claims with no constant or cited source. They need checking against Treasury and Parliament records and a dated source.

claims: with a further cut to 14% on 1 July 2027
whys: This is a typed rate, not taken from a constant. It should come from a TAX_BRACKETS_2027_28 constant.

claims: Under this marginal system ... you only pay the repayment percentage on income above each threshold, not on your entire income.
whys: Contradicts the paragraph above it (line 139), which says the top band is a percentage of total repayment income from HECS_HELP.bands[3].min. The 'not on your entire income' rule is only true below the top band.
reviewerNotes: The writer's fact questions are valid and stay as written. Line 142 ('not on your entire income') contradicts the top HECS band, which charges a percentage of total repayment income. Line 105 ('settings are now confirmed') sits beside pending Medicare thresholds and the pending Payday Super cap relief. Line 123 ('decade-long increase') is loose. Lines 160, 205 and 252 have figures typed into the prose instead of drawn from constants.

claims: The year's settings are now confirmed.
whys: The Medicare section on the same page (line 147) says no 2026-27 Medicare levy low-income thresholds have been legislated yet, and the Payday Super cap relief is still pending. 'Settings are now confirmed' overstates it.

claims: Carry-forward of unused concessional cap amounts from the previous 5 years if total super balance is under $500,000; LITO up to $700 phasing out $37,500 to $66,667 (line 160); $268 / $5.15 rate-cut figures; NMW $24.95 to $26.44.
whys: These figures are not wrong as far as I can tell, but they are typed into the prose instead of coming from constants. That makes them likely to go stale. Note that the $500,000 test applies to the balance at 30 June of the previous year.
constants: SUPER_GUARANTEE / LITO / NATIONAL_MINIMUM_WAGE constants in lib/constants
